name: Bebshoru Lodbuka
detailed_description:
This is a turn-based combat game where you have to fight against the demons of Bebshoru Lodbuka's hell until you reach the deepest caverns where the supreme darkness of Trekim Gogzokk dwells. In each of the 30 levels you will fight a guardian demon until you reach the final fight.
In the fights you use cards that you can buy in the Marketplace and then throw them when you are fighting. These cards can have effects on your enemy and also on yourself.
There are 5 difficulty levels, and you can save your avatar at any time in addition to the current game, so you can start a new game with your previous avatar to not lose the evolution.
To play you have to use the mouse mainly except in the Marketplace where you can optionally use the Enter key on an item for sale to select how many units you want.
When you choose a higher difficulty level you won't be able to win unless you do some better combat strategy, but at easier levels you can relax a bit.
You have about 500 cards to buy and you are given more coins each time you pass a level.
Death is permanent, so don't forget to save the game if you want to play it again.

Both you and your enemy have multiple skills such as Strength, Destruction instinct, Protection, Witchery, Psychic Power, Intelligence and Consciousness, as well as needs that you must satisfy in order not to reduce your energy, such as Hunger, Thirst, Mood and Clothing. You also have a Mental Strength that you must keep high enough so as not to fall asleep, consuming some food, drinking a potion or by means of some spell.

You have a time limit of 2 minutes to play your turn, and then the turn automatically passes to your enemy, although you can pass it before without playing if you wish. You can also pause the game to give you time to work out a better strategy, except on the hardest level called Hell where the timer never stops.

The card system (called tokens in the game) has been crafted to be precise and intuitive. By casting a token you can change some of your skills, needs, and other properties, as well as those of your enemy. In addition, the effects of a thrown token can be instantaneous or can last for a certain time or a certain number of combat turns, so you can accumulate the effect of several moves to make a medium-term strategy, there are even tokens that when you throw them allow you to immediately perform several more moves in a row in your current turn without automatically passing the turn to your enemy.

You have 5 evolutionary levels available: Human, Apprentice, Warrior, Master and Demigod, although you can also acquire advanced robotic bodies.

Using special spells or potions you can also temporarily become a demon, animal or even a spirit, although you should know that certain tokens can only be cast by a wizard and others only by demons, animals or spirits.

Items such as a sword, a hammer, a potion, a talisman, a drink, a food or a special attack with a hammer are all tokens available in the Marketplace, some of which can have a limited number of uses such as a hammer, and others such as raw beef have an expiration date and cause illness if consumed out of time; although consuming rotten meat also infects your teeth and this allows you to perform certain special attacks with infected bites...

You also have the option to enable the Game Master:

An entity who will give you advice and can do you favors, although he can also punish you if he is angry with you and wishes to do so. You can make him offerings to please him or sacrifices to appease his anger. You can also ask him to give you gifts, and he may impose challenges that you must fulfill in time to avoid angering him, but if you fulfill them, he will give you a prize. The Game Master will show his emotions towards you when he wishes.

There are many hidden things you can discover and different strategies to achieve your goals!

short_description: Turn-based combat game where you will fight against the demons of Bebshoru Lodbuka's hell until you reach Trekim Gogzokk's lair, and thus banish the darkness from the land of Abunouzeppan. You can make combat strategies by throwing cards that are sold in the Marketplace.
supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (or newer)
  • Processor: 3GHz 4-core CPU or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: integrated GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1920x1080 screen resolution

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
